description: This Java class 'UpdateService' extends WearableListenerService to handle data layer events from Android Wear devices, specifically processing location data updates and managing data item deletions.

classes.name: UpdateService
classes.description: A service that listens for data layer events from wearable devices, processes location data, and manages data item deletions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient and DataManager, and connects to the Google API client.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data events, extracts location data, updates the data manager, and schedules data item deletion.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful connection to GoogleApiClient, including deleting queued data items.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connection (empty implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of data item deletion, logs errors if deletion fails.
